blurb: The Inside Game: the Wayne Embry story, told from his memoir. A Hardwood Bricks film with JuiceboxNationTV and 19 North Films. Miami edition.
disclosure: Archive footage of Wayne Embry with the Cincinnati Royals is used under fair use for commentary; slow motion is frame-interpolated. Original score.

reels.title: The Inside Game: March 6, 1972
reels.text: In 1972, no major American sports league had a Black general manager. Then the Milwaukee Bucks made a call. Wayne Embry's story, in his words.
